description: Operator dashboard for the discord-bot service: Claude API spend and tokens, prompt cache hit rate, question outcomes and limits, tool calls, issue filing, and Discord connection health. Spend is estimated from token counts and the price variables (USD per million tokens); the defaults are Claude Haiku 5.5's.

panels.title: Spend (range)
panels.description: Estimated Claude API spend over the selected time range, from token counts and the price variables at the top of the dashboard (USD per million tokens).

targets.expr: (sum(increase(discordbot_model_tokens_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", type="input"}[$__range])) * $price_input + sum(increase(discordbot_model_tokens_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", type="cache_read"}[$__range])) * $price_cache_read + sum(increase(discordbot_model_tokens_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", type="cache_write"}[$__range])) * $price_cache_write + sum(increase(discordbot_model_tokens_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", type="output"}[$__range])) * $price_output) / 1e6

panels.title: Questions (range)
panels.description: Questions that reached the model in the selected range (answered, limited, refused or error).

panels.title: Cost per question
panels.description: Average estimated spend per question that reached the model, over the selected range.

targets.expr: (sum(increase(discordbot_model_tokens_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", type="input"}[$__range])) * $price_input + sum(increase(discordbot_model_tokens_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", type="cache_read"}[$__range])) * $price_cache_read + sum(increase(discordbot_model_tokens_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", type="cache_write"}[$__range])) * $price_cache_write + sum(increase(discordbot_model_tokens_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", type="output"}[$__range])) * $price_output) / 1e6 / sum(increase(discordbot_questions_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", outcome=~"answered|limited|refused|error|silent"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Cache hit rate
panels.description: Share of input tokens read from the prompt cache over the selected range (cache reads / all input). Low values mean caching isn't working.

panels.title: Discord
panels.description: Whether the bot's Discord gateway connection is up.

panels.title: In progress
panels.description: Questions being answered right now.

panels.title: Spend per hour by token type
panels.description: Estimated USD per hour, by what the tokens were billed as. Output (which includes thinking) usually dominates.

panels.title: Tokens per second by type
panels.description: Raw token throughput by billing type.

panels.title: Tokens per question
panels.description: Percentiles of tokens processed per question across all its model calls. Compare with LLM_TOKENS_PER_QUESTION (the tokens_per_question label on discordbot_info).

panels.title: Cache hit rate
panels.description: Share of input tokens read from the prompt cache.

panels.title: Questions by outcome
panels.description: answered; limited (hit a per-question limit); refused (model declined); error; rate_limited (user over their limit); busy (user already had a question running). Per minute.

panels.title: Limits hit
panels.description: Questions that hit a per-question limit, by which, per minute: rounds, budget, context, output.

panels.title: Time to answer
panels.description: Percentiles of time from starting work on a question to the reply.

panels.title: Questions in progress
panels.description: Concurrent questions; capped by MAX_CONCURRENT_QUESTIONS.

panels.title: Requests by result
panels.description: Claude API requests per minute: ok, rate_limited (429), overloaded (529), server_error, client_error, network.

panels.title: Request latency
panels.description: Claude API request latency percentiles (one request per tool round).

panels.title: Tool calls by tool
panels.description: Tool calls per minute by tool (all results).

panels.title: Tool errors and skips
panels.description: Failed (error) and not-run (skipped, because of a per-question or per-round limit) tool calls per minute.

panels.title: Tool latency (p90)
panels.description: 90th percentile latency by tool: stats API, server query, Discord or GitHub round trips.

panels.title: Drafted (range)
panels.description: Issue drafts shown to users.

panels.title: Filed (range)
panels.description: Drafts confirmed and filed on GitHub.

panels.title: Cancelled (range)
panels.description: Drafts the reporter cancelled.

panels.title: Failed (range)
panels.description: Confirmed drafts GitHub rejected.

panels.title: Bugs filed (range)
panels.description: Filed bug reports.

panels.title: Features filed (range)
panels.description: Filed feature requests.

panels.title: Issue activity
panels.description: Issue drafts by action, per hour.

panels.title: Discord connection
panels.description: 1 while connected; connection events (connect, disconnect, resume) per hour.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Resident memory and Go heap in use.

panels.title: CPU and goroutines
panels.description: CPU cores used and goroutine count.

list.description: USD per million uncached input tokens. Default: Claude Haiku 5.5.
list.label: $/MTok input
list.name: price_input

list.description: USD per million tokens read from the prompt cache (0.1x input on Haiku 5.5).
list.label: $/MTok cache read
list.name: price_cache_read

list.description: USD per million tokens written to the 5-minute prompt cache (1.25x input).
list.label: $/MTok cache write
list.name: price_cache_write

list.description: USD per million output tokens, thinking included. Default: Claude Haiku 5.5.
list.label: $/MTok output
list.name: price_output
